metanarrative_source: Canonical SLOP_METANARRATIV_R1.md reread from docs/kfb-decisions-register-2026-10-11; new biographies remain DESIGN, calls are proposals and not canonical Triplet excerpts

records.name: Cedric Manymiles
records.biography_en: He carries MiB instructions between HyperNorm eras and has begun charging by contradiction.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The shortest route has the longest form.

records.name: Vera Boltwise
records.biography_en: Her approved patterns cover dissonant cards beautifully; she saves the offcuts for questions.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The lining has a different account of events.

records.name: Ned Spicerisk
records.biography_en: Hunky and Dory insist every aroma has a category; Ned proposes elsewhere.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The sample has entered the air supply.

records.name: Ollie Phrasebook
records.biography_en: The Men in Black value his talent for turning disagreement into delayed agreement.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The translation is faithful to the invoice.

records.name: Nora Cupstop
records.biography_en: She serves every HyperNorm faction from the same kettle and calls the policy hot water.

records.name: Giles Latchlast
records.biography_en: He has been authorized by MiB to detain all objects from unapproved centuries.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The luggage is older than the jurisdiction.
